environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a single EC2 instance (m5.large) behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough. pgBouncer running in transaction pooling mode on port 6432. No rate limiting configured. Application listens directly on port 8080 with NLB forwarding TCP connections. The /internal/* routes are accessible from any source IP. No jitter injection at the infrastructure level.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no TLS termination
